bugs.text: Challenge stage never ends: challenge.bonus is initialised to 0 but the end-of-stage tally runs only if ch.bonus < 0, so after all waves pass the game stays in 'challenge' mode forever with no enemies (soft-lock at stage 3, 7, ...).
tryFire returns unless game.mode === 'play', so the player cannot shoot at all during challenging stages (mode 'challenge'); hits, wave bonuses and PERFECT are unreachable.
Breathing requires every enemy in its slot, so it stops whenever any enemy dives or returns; the formation mostly sways rather than breathes once dives begin.
Escort picker can choose the same Goei twice, giving fewer escorts than intended.
Freed fighter is only updated in play mode and is lost if the player is dead/respawning when it reaches the bottom.
During the capture animation player bullets are not collision-checked and pass through enemies.
When one half of a dual fighter is captured, the remaining ship is not re-centred.

summary: A clean, well-organised single-file clone with separated state/update/render, a proper fixed-timestep loop, integer-scaled pixel-art sprites with two-frame animation, spline-based entry groups and dives, correct point values including escort-scaled Boss scoring, and a full tractor beam / capture / rescue / dual-fighter loop that matches the spec closely. Stages 1 and 2 play like Galaga, as the play-test confirms (no errors, scoring, game over, return to title with saved high score). The big failure is the Challenging Stage: the player cannot fire there (tryFire is gated on mode 'play') and the stage-end tally is guarded by an impossible condition (bonus < 0 when it starts at 0), so every game hard-locks at stage 3 with the hits/bonus screen never shown. Smaller deviations: breathing that stops whenever any enemy is out of formation, a missing 30 badge and sine-wave rather than looping challenge paths.
